_comment: CWC station registry for multi-station analysis and forecasting (src/cwc_adapter.py, src/hydro_analysis.py, src/river_forecast.py). Identity fields were read from rwl_tel_hr_cwc_009_2021_2025.csv and are re-checked against every row on load. Datums are ASSUMED (the file does not state them). Nothing here is an official threshold.

UPPER_ANICUT._analysis_note: analysis_max_constant_run_hours applies to analysis and forecasting only, on top of config/river_qc.json (never weaker). The River Agent's evidence for this station is unchanged.

METTUR._note: A reservoir LEVEL, not a release or a river gauge. Never compared with or used as a river level.

main_stem_order.source: Course of the Cauvery main stem (Mettur dam -> Erode -> Kodumudi -> Musiri -> Upper Anicut/Mukkombu). Consistent with the file: all three are on the Cauvery main stem (Tributary '-'), and zero-gauge levels fall downstream (Musiri 78.0 m, Upper Anicut 72.6 m). Station order is not proof of a measurable hydraulic relationship: that is tested from the data (upstream_validation).

upstream_validation._comment: Prototype acceptance rule: an upstream candidate is used only if its level CHANGES correlate with the primary station's changes at some lag 0-24 h with |r| >= 0.3 over >= 500 aligned pairs. Changes, not absolute levels, are compared so differing datums cannot create a spurious relationship.
